_comment: MCP config handed to an agent job ONLY when the job sets "mcp": true (the runner passes
--mcp-config <this file> --strict-mcp-config). A copy of the repo's .mcp.json server block,
kept here so it is versioned with the runner; the launch folder itself carries no .mcp.json,
because an attached server costs every agent its tool inventory + ServerInfo.Instructions in
context. Classifiers and referees never need it; investigators querying the plan or lineage do.
Keep in step with .mcp.json (same publish path, same env).
